input.quote: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
input.rationale: Section 4.2 imposes a stipulated termination payment payable by us (the Company) to HDI whenever we terminate — including on an ordinary 90-day non-renewal under Section 4.1 — measured as one half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000. Because our fees under Section 3.1 are only 30% of Net Sales above $11,000/month, this formula can exceed a full year's fees and is uncapped, so it fails the fallback of an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees and approaches walk-away territory (penalty triggered by routine termination). Our preference is deletion; given HDI builds and hosts the Site at no upfront cost, we proposed the fallback three-month cap as the sole amount due on termination. The instalment mechanic in 4.2(c) is unobjectionable once capped, and the "without penalty" termination right in Section 1.6 runs in our favour.

proposal.summary: Cap the Company-payable Termination Payment at three months' fees and make it the sole amount due on termination
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that no liquidated damages or penalties should be payable by us, so we would prefer to delete the Termination Payment; recognizing HDI's build investment, we have instead capped it at our accepted fallback of three months' fees as the sole amount due on termination, since a formula based on half of trailing twelve-month Net Sales can exceed the annual value of the fees we pay and is triggered by an ordinary non-renewal notice.

ops.oldText: the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the balance of which shall be divided by two; provided that the Termination Payment shall in no event exceed an amount equal to three (3) months' fees under Section 3.1 (calculated using the average monthly fees payable during the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date), and shall be the sole and exclusive amount payable by the Company in connection with such termination.
